up: Retrieve all drug-indication relationships from the drug_indication table. For each record, provide the molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), the molecule preferred name (pref_name), the ChEBI parent ID (if available; otherwise NULL), the MeSH identifier (mesh_id), the EFO identifier (efo_id), the indication label (mesh_heading or efo_term), and the max phase for indication (max_phase_for_ind). Do not apply any filters; return all rows. Join drug_indication with molecule_dictionary using molregno. For the ChEBI parent ID, if no direct column exists in the database, return NULL.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, NULL AS chebi_parent_id, di.mesh_id, di.efo_id, COALESCE(di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term) AS indication_label, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM drug_indication di LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON di.molregno = md.molregno;
